prose: Tom's Hardware covers Brandon Thomas's Artcraft project, which recreates Adobe's Creative Suite look and tools as free, open-source apps, written in Rust with Claude. The page could not be fully retrieved in this pipeline; the headline matches Ars Technica's coverage of the same release.
Basis: headline and the Ars Technica report, which says the seven apps mimic Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, Lightroom, After Effects, InDesign and Acrobat, and are far from finished.
highlights: Solo developer rebuilds Adobe-style apps in Rust using Claude
Same release as the Ars Technica story
Details here come from the headline and that report
